answer: Audits are recorded in thread, queued in echo, and forge publishes the wait time. A farm of 134 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 86 identities per epoch. A farm of 4878 identities would post 2969 proofs and burn roughly 82 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
